title: Self-supported NiTe@NiMo electrodes enabling efficient sulfion oxidation reaction toward energy-saving and chlorine-free hybrid seawater electrolysis at high current densities
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1440-1451
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05379F, Paper
Hao Tan, Zhipeng Yu, Chenyue Zhang, Fei Lin, Shiyu Ma, Haoliang Huang, Hong Li, Dehua Xiong, Lifeng Liu
NiTe@NiMo/NF electrodes show outstanding electrocatalytic performance for sulfion oxidation in seawater, able to stably operate at a high current density under a low voltage, simultaneously producing H2 and sulfur in an energy-saving manner.
